notes: Boards: five public boards with threads, replies, photos, video and likes. You can edit and delete your own posts.
Groups: open and closed chats. Closed chats are found by a 4-digit number and a code, and are end-to-end encrypted.
Photos, video and voice in chats, locked on your phone. Your own camera, with hands-free filming up to 10 minutes.
Voice: connect your microphone, everyone in the chat hears you, tap your name to mute.
Reply to a message by pressing it long. Double tap for <3, triple tap for </3.
Pseudonyms with a 6-digit code to log in on another phone. Anonymous by default.
Notifications for boards and chats. Closed chats never say who wrote.
Messages and threads expire. Chats remember a limited number of messages, the oldest turn red before they go.
No accounts, no logs, no back-ups. Your phone keeps its key to itself and proves ownership per post.
Admin page to clean up and set the limits. The admin can delete, not read.
Install page with steps and a QR code, a manifesto, themes graphite and paper, a secret page.
